channel.title: Mayank Deshpande
channel.description: Personal site and blog of Mayank Deshpande — engineering, AI research, and the occasional liner notes.

item.title: Reproducing AutoFEA: When an LLM Writes the Finite Element Model
item.description: I rebuilt AutoFEA, where an LLM writes a CalculiX deck guided by a GCN-Transformer retriever and answers from the solver, from the paper and the authors' notebook. The paper reports 90.2 %. My first converged run got 10 %. Here is why: a retriever that learned the base rate, and a case study whose inputs can't produce its answer.

item.title: pi harness: A Self-Service Platform for Document-Grounded Agents
item.description: Upload your PDFs, Office files and spreadsheets, write instructions, publish, and chat. pi harness turns a team's documents into a cited, guard-railed agent on the pi SDK and Gemini — with streaming tool timelines and sandboxed dashboards.

item.title: Draw Your Agents: A Visual AI Agent Builder That Runs Entirely in Your Browser
item.description: Meet Draw Your Agents: a drag-and-drop, no-code visual AI agent builder that compiles your agent workflow into a runnable Google ADK Python project. It runs 100% in your browser — no server, no sign-up, and your code never leaves your machine.

item.title: South Bengaluru, a Stove, and Old War Songs
item.description: Liner notes from a 26-year-old's life in south Bengaluru — why I left a 1BHK for a PG, how cooking set me free, balancing work and the GMAT, and why I keep returning to old rock and metal as the world gets louder.

item.title: PDEpilot: Natural Language to Verified Solver Code
item.description: Meet PDEpilot: a fully autonomous multi-agent system that transforms natural language PDE descriptions into production-grade solver code — routing to OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, or SciPy — with intelligent preconditioning and self-correcting feedback loops.

item.title: Lang-PINN: Bridging Natural Language and Scientific Simulation
item.description: Meet Lang-PINN: An LLM-driven multi-agent framework that bridges the gap between natural language and scientific simulation. Discover how four specialized agents automate the design, coding, and optimization of Physics-Informed Neural Networks.

item.title: From Hover to SecureLogin: My Raspberry Pi Automation Journey
item.description: Discover how tinkering with a Raspberry Pi led to smarter living, automation, and the creation of SecureLogin. This article covers project highlights, technical insights, and tips for your own automation journey.

item.title: Understanding How Neural Networks Learn: A Peek into Physics and Frequencies
item.description: Explore the fascinating world of neural networks and their learning mechanisms. This article delves into the physics behind neural networks, spectral bias, and the role of differential equations in shaping their learning processes.
